name: Street Altercation
description: Someone got in your face after the battle. Now you have to decide how to handle it.

chapters.title: After the Battle
chapters.description: Someone from your opponent's crew stepped to you in the parking lot. Words were exchanged. Hands might be next.

choices.label: Swing First
choices.description: You're not about to let them think you're scared.

choices.label: Stand Your Ground
choices.description: Keep it verbal but don't back down an inch.

choices.label: Walk Away
choices.description: Not worth it. You've got more to lose than they do.

chapters.title: Hands Thrown
chapters.description: It's on. Security's coming but they're not here yet.

choices.label: Handle Your Business
choices.description: You're scrapping. Give them everything you got.

choices.label: Security Breaks It Up
choices.description: Security pulls you apart before there's a clear winner.

chapters.title: Eye to Eye
chapters.description: You're face to face. Neither of you is backing down. The crowd is watching.

choices.label: They Swing First
choices.description: They couldn't hold it together. Now you're defending yourself.

choices.label: Crews Separate You
choices.description: Both sides pull their people apart. It's over - for now.

chapters.title: The Aftermath
chapters.description: You handled that. But now there's video everywhere and people are talking.

choices.label: Stay Quiet
choices.description: Don't say anything. Let the footage speak.

choices.label: Talk Your Shit
choices.description: Go on social media and clown them. You earned it.

chapters.title: Both Sides Got Licks
chapters.description: Nobody won that clean. You're both a little busted up. Leagues are watching.

choices.label: Squash It
choices.description: Reach out. Nobody needs this to go further.

choices.label: Keep That Energy
choices.description: You see them again, it's on sight.

chapters.title: Round Two
chapters.description: They caught you at the next event. This time they brought more people.

choices.label: Fight Anyway
choices.description: Numbers don't matter. You're not running.

choices.label: Your People Show Up
choices.description: Your crew heard what happened. They're here now.

choices.label: Security Intervenes
choices.description: The league had extra security. They shut it down before it started.

endings.title: Cooler Heads
endings.description: You walked away. Some people respect it. Some people don't. You'll have to live with their opinions.

endings.title: Separated
endings.description: Security got there in time. Neither of you got hurt bad. The beef is officially on though.

endings.title: Unfinished Business
endings.description: It's not over. Everyone knows it. You'll see them again eventually.

endings.title: Street Credibility
endings.description: You handled yours and kept it moving. The culture respects that. People know not to play with you.

endings.title: Beef Squashed
endings.description: You both agreed to leave it in the past. Respect was kept on both sides. It's over.

endings.title: Caught Slipping
endings.description: They got you good. You're hurt but you'll recover. This changed the dynamic though - they think they can touch you.

endings.title: All Out Brawl
endings.description: It turned into a war. Multiple people hurt. Cops got called. Everyone involved is getting heat from the leagues.
